h1: Custom Heavyweight Pullovers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom heavyweight pullovers in bulk for your team or event. Durable, warm, and perfect for branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom heavyweight pullovers are built for durability and warmth, making them a smart choice for corporate gifts, team uniforms, or safety incentives. Unlike lighter pullovers, these 9-12 oz cotton-rich sweatshirts hold up to frequent washing and outdoor wear. Choose from full-zip hoodies like the Jerzees Super Sweats or a classic pullover style. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look that stays visible season after season.
heroAltText: Custom heavyweight pullovers for bulk orders with screen printing, featuring a durable hooded sweatshirt
